verdict.rationale: Extend's data-handling docs describe zero-data-retention options, including ZDR with AI subprocessors configurable per workspace, plus deletion APIs for every resource and BYOC/VPC deployments. Together these limit how customer data persists and could indirectly keep it out of model training, but nothing explicitly says customer data is excluded from training or offers a training opt-out. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training-on-customer-data policy or opt-out control, clarity on whether ZDR is the default or a paid-tier option, independent corroboration.
